baseline.name: Delete each matching value by shifting its suffix
baseline.approach: When val is found, move every later element one slot left and continue.

archived.name: Stable read/write compaction
archived.space: O(1) auxiliary space; input is modified

why: A write cursor retains useful elements directly, avoiding repeated movement of the same suffix.
quantitative_comparison: Repeated deletion can move n(n-1)/2 elements when all values are removed. Compaction performs n value tests and at most n retained-element writes; for that all-removed case it performs zero writes. These are element-operation counts, not a stopwatch speedup.
tradeoffs: Both modify the array. The returned length defines the useful prefix; trailing values are not cleared or deallocated.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
